name: Wooting keyboards
description: Per-key lighting of the Wooting keyboards (One, Two, Two Lekker Edition, Two HE, 60HE family, 80HE, UwU RGB; every gamepad-emulation product id) over the V2 (usage page 0x1337) and V3 (usage page 0xFF55) firmware reports. Adapted from OpenRGB's WootingKeyboardController (GPL-2.0-or-later); untested on hardware. Sends only the colour-init, raw-colour and (at shutdown) reset-all colour commands; nothing is stored. Protocol notes: docs/hardware/wooting.md.
